name: Yin Yang Yo!
description: Two 11-year-old rabbit twins named Yin and Yang train under Master Yo, a grumpy old panda. They learn the sacred art of Woo Foo, a special type of martial arts that involves both might and magic. They must work together to save the world from evil villains and forces that want to destroy, corrupt or take it over. However, through all these adventures, Yin and Yang still portray stereotypical siblings; belligerently antagonistic but still ultimately caring about each other and working together if needed.

videos.title: Dojo, Oh No!
videos.overview: Yang hurts Yin's feelings when he starts training under Ultimoose.

videos.title: Finding Hershel
videos.overview: Master Yo gives his young protégés a test, which involves having them watch a seemingly harmless rock named Hershel.

videos.title: 600 Channels of Doom!
videos.overview: Carl, the Evil Cockroach wizard, gives Yin and Yang a new TV with only one remote. Yin and Yang fight over the remote, giving Carl a chance to destroy them.

videos.title: An Oldie But a Goodie
videos.overview: Yin and Yang tell Yo that he is old, and Yo makes them pick up his medication. Yo throws a party to look cool, but Yin and Yang make Yo's old enemy, Kraggler, mad. Kraggler turns everyone, except Yin and Yang, into old people.

videos.title: Yin Yang Yuck!
videos.overview: Yin and Yang wish to lose their bossiness and aggression and in the process accidentally create a new villain, Yuck.

videos.title: Beetlemania
videos.overview: Yang fakes being a Woo Foo Warrior to impress a girl. To prove his skills, he has to take out a huge steel beetle.

videos.title: Enter: The Ant
videos.overview: Yin and Yang try to teach Yo that it's not good to boss kids around, but little do they know, Herman the Evil Ant is waiting for the panda to leave so he can conquer the world.

videos.title: Sweet Stench of Love
videos.overview: Yin and Yang get into a fight while cleaning their room, and when Yin costs Yang the world record at a video game, he refuses to shower until one of them cracks and apologizes. But Yang is soon encouraged to clean himself up when his odor attracts the amorous advances of Malodia the Elephant, Princess of the Stink Aardvarks.

videos.title: Woo Foo Flu
videos.overview: Yin comes down with a case of the Woo Foo Flu, an illness that causes her to bend reality whenever she sneezes. Master Yo orders Yang to take care of her while Master Yo concocts an antidote for the Woo Foo Flu. However, Yin later gets captured by Carl - who intends to exploit her illness so it can help him take over the world - and Yang may have to get himself sick to save Yin.

videos.title: The Imagination Situation
videos.overview: Yin and Yang use Zarnot to boost their popularity by lying. When Zarnot becomes huge, they must prove that they are telling the truth.

videos.title: Aura... or Not
videos.overview: Yin's Woo Foo Aura gets out of control, trying to save the environment and escapes Yin's body, destroying the town.

videos.title: Falling Yin Love
videos.overview: Yin falls in love with a person named Brett who actually turns out to be Yuck.

videos.title: On Golden Pondscum
videos.overview: Yin and Yang have to stop Pondscum from stealing Yo's golden chair.

videos.title: Old School
videos.overview: Kraggler uses the cronalogicum to trade ages with Yin and Yang so he can become young again.

videos.title: A Toy's Story
videos.overview: Yang won a doll at the county fair for Yin, but the doll is actually Zarnot.

videos.title: The Trouble with Two-ni-corns
videos.overview: Yo tells Yin to go to the valley of the two-ni-corns and find a rainbow mane The Gnu to fix her toy. Meanwhile, Yang is taken over by Ultimoose.

videos.title: Scarf It Up!
videos.overview: Saranoia makes a snow day so that Yin and Yang can play outside and Yin may have a day off, as she holds an obsession with Yin's future

videos.title: Return of the Night Master
videos.overview: The Night Master rebuilds his armies that were frozen years ago by Master Yo. Little do they know, Yin and Yang are involved in his plan.

videos.title: My Stupid Sword
videos.overview: Yang is thrilled that the CPK (Chung Pow Kitties; a pastiche of Hello Kitty and Powerpuff Girls), a rock band made of cats with mad ninja skills in town. Not only that, but they also appear on Broadway and are looking for a new member. Having a sharp sword is a requirement. Yang's bamboo sword isn't sharp enough, but Master Yo refuses to give Yang a new sword. Yang plots to steal weapons from the Forbidden Armory to try to make the cut.

videos.title: Neat Freak
videos.overview: Yin meets a hamster who loves to clean while she is out buying cleaning supplies. The hamster reveals himself to be Fastidious, and asks the Woo Foo students to help him defeat some of the spirits who have been making a mess. However, there is something sinister about Fastidious.

videos.title: The High She-as
videos.overview: Yin and Yang are fishing when a group of female pirates appear. They act really nice towards Yin, but not so much towards Yang. Are these pirates all they appear to be, or is there something else about them?

videos.title: A Match Not Made In Heaven
videos.overview: Carl wants to use his mother's destructive jewelry for his nefarious purposes (especially since she never wears them) but his mother, Edna, won't let him. Meanwhile, Yang pulls a practical joke on Master Yo by posting his bio on a website for dating service for old people. Master Yo's blind date turns out to be Edna. Can Yin and Yang break up this relationship that's not meant to be before Carl can take advantage of his mother's absence?

videos.title: Scary Scary Quite Contrary
videos.overview: Master Yo shows Yin and Yang that black-and-white films can be scary.

videos.title: How the Cookie Crumbles
videos.overview: Yin uses the misfortune cookies on Yang to take away his good luck.

videos.title: The Yin of Yang
videos.overview: Yang is really interested in a girl named Lina, who is Yin's really good friend. The trouble is, Yang's behavior turns Lina off. So Master Yo suggests that Yang should try to be more like Yin in order to make Lina like him.

videos.title: Shopping Sprawl
videos.overview: Yin and Yang are fed up with not getting an allowance from Master Yo for doing chores around the dojo. Then a stranger appears, announcing the opening of a new UltraMega Mall in their town and giving the two young warriors credit cards to their heart's content. Are Yin and Yang playing directly into an evil villain's plans?

videos.title: Wubble in Paradise
videos.overview: Yin and Yang host an awards show for evil Brother Herman.

videos.title: Dictator of the Year
videos.overview: The Night Master hides in Yang's imagination.

videos.title: Master Dave
videos.overview: A new master is in charge.

videos.title: Destination Danger
videos.overview: A fun road trip serves as a cover for a covert operation.

videos.title: Bad Nanny Jamma
videos.overview: Dressed as a donkey, Yin and Yang infiltrate a bad-guy convention.

videos.title: Pros and Cons
videos.overview: Saranoia returns.

videos.title: The Gig Is Up
videos.overview: Yin and Yang meet the legendary Woo Foo twins.

videos.title: Doomed to Repeat It
videos.overview: Coop teams up with Yin and Yang to win back an ancient Woo Foo artifact.

videos.title: Family Day
videos.overview: Herman and Carl want to give their mom a pair of rabbit's feet for luck.

videos.title: The Hex of the Ex
videos.overview: Master Yo's ex-girlfriends show up.

videos.title: Out on a Pledge
videos.overview: Yang finally makes some guy friends, but they're not who they say they are.

videos.title: Dojo Alone
videos.overview: Brother Herman attacks while Master Yo is away.

videos.title: Attack of the Lesson
videos.overview: A heavy-handed hero teaches everyone a lesson.

videos.title: A Case of Evils
videos.overview: Yin and Yang wonder if Master Yo is really evil.

videos.title: Attack of the Vidiots
videos.overview: Yang acts up in a video game.

videos.title: Fit to be Tried
videos.overview: Yin and Yang are put on trial.

videos.title: Voyage to the Center of the Yo
videos.overview: Yin and Yang follow Yuck to a terrifying place... inside Master Yo.

videos.title: Sitting Shaggler
videos.overview: Shaggler turns into a baby.

videos.title: Shadows and Light
videos.overview: Yang uses an ancient tool to end Yin's constant pursuit of popularity.

videos.title: The Truth Hurts
videos.overview: Yin and Yang are promoted.

videos.title: Who Knows What Evil Lurks
videos.overview: Information on Yin and Yang is leaked to the Night Master and the twins try to find the culprit.

videos.title: Night Fall
videos.overview: The Night Master plots to kidnap Master Yo so he can plunge the world into darkness and be free.

videos.title: The Pecking Order
videos.overview: Yin and Yang prepare to go on vacation. Coop returns and tried to warn them of The Night Master's energy escaping, but they ignore him until it's too late.

videos.title: Party Favors
videos.overview: Coop's mom is throwing a "welcome back/thanks for saving the world all by yourself" party, and Yin and Yang are the only ones not invited. Meanwhile, three flunkies join together and try to get into The Night Master's fortress. However, they need the spare key, which the Night Master gave to Coop!

videos.title: Smoke and Mirrors
videos.overview: Yin and Yang are pitted against each other in a fight.

videos.title: Yin-Credible!
videos.overview: Yin takes credit for saving the mayor, without acknowledging Yang's help.

videos.title: Brain Drain
videos.overview: Yang's brain becomes controlled by a villain known as Mastermind.

videos.title: The Big Payback
videos.overview: Master Yo faces an old nemesis he has never been able to defeat.

videos.title: Imperfect Fooplicates
videos.overview: Yin and Yang uses a magical bracelet to make fooplicates of themselves until Yuck returns.

videos.title: Messy Relationships
videos.overview: Melodia the Aardvark Princess returns to claim Yang until Fastidous makes Yin mad with the Stink Aardvarks.

videos.title: A Bad Case of the Buglies
videos.overview: Carl casts an ugly spell on Yin and Yang after Yin insults Carl and calls him a "buglie".

videos.title: Control Issues
videos.overview: Yin and Yang learn self-control at an institute, but its founder, Ultimoose, may have more sinister plans in store.

videos.title: Foreign Exchange Problem
videos.overview: Yin and Yang get a lesson in cultural enrichment when a foreign exchange student from Redneckistan named Jobeaux shows up. Meanwhile, the Chung Pow Kitties return in search of a powerful Woo Foo artifact. Yin and Yang suspect that there is more to Jobeaux than meets the eye.

videos.title: Turnabout
videos.overview: Master Yo is sick of Yin and Yang disrespecting him. Yin and Yang are sick of Master Yo treating them like babies. When young Kraggler switches ages with Yo (part of a diabolical plan), Yin and Yang are forced to babysit the three-year-old Yo, and he reveals how powerful (and bratty) he was as a child.

videos.title: The Manotaur
videos.overview: Yin and Yang attempt to defeat a half-human, half-bull monster.

videos.title: League of Evil
videos.overview: Carl forms a league of evil with three other villains when they all rent an apartment together.

videos.title: This Yang Isn't Brought To You By ...
videos.overview: Yang endorses a toy line for money but doesn't realize that the toys are harmful to children.

videos.title: Stuck
videos.overview: Yin, Yang and some of their friends accept a free vacation to a mysterious island, not knowing that it's a trap set by Smoke.

videos.title: Deja Foo
videos.overview: Ultimoose and Yang search for an amulet that will give them all of the Night Master's powers.

videos.title: Gone-A-Fowl
videos.overview: Yin reluctantly goes on a date with Coop, and she falls under his evil spell.

videos.title: Basic Yin-stinct
videos.overview: Carl tricks Yin into eating seeds that make her doubt everything.

videos.title: Fighting Fooberty
videos.overview: Mr. Pondscum realizes he isn't a goldfish but a polliwog.

videos.title: Yin Yang Carl
videos.overview: Carl magically switches brains with Master Yo in an attempt to destroy the Woo Fo warriors.

videos.title: Smorks
videos.overview: Yin takes in some seemingly harmless green creatures as pets, but Yang believes they are dangerous.

videos.title: Wonder Tweens Go!
videos.overview: Yin and Yang become addicted to a TV show about a superhero but learn they should focus instead on becoming heroes in real life.

videos.title: Touchy Feelings
videos.overview: Yang loses his emotions after he is zapped by Fred.

videos.title: O'Brother There Art Thou
videos.overview: When Yang separates himself from Yin and Master Yo, he saves a robot, and they start to act like brothers. But Yin is feeling suspicious and jealous and discovers the robot is actually a spy made by Zarnot sent to destroy Yang.

videos.title: An Inconvenient Tooth
videos.overview: Yang develops a rare tooth condition and could end up as dinner on Edna's table.

videos.title: Situation Tragedy
videos.overview: Carl traps Yin and Yang in a sitcom with a magic remote.

videos.title: Skirting the Issue
videos.overview: Yang receives a powerful artifact, but it's a skirt and he refuses to wear it.

videos.title: Moon Over My Yinnie
videos.overview: Carl attempts to blot out the rays of the sun.

videos.title: Clown-Fu Fighting
videos.overview: When Yang finds out that Master Yo knows a form of fighting known as Clown Fu, he wants to learn the various techniques for himself.

videos.title: Cat Smash Fever
videos.overview: The Chung Pow Kitties are desperately trying to claim the Licking Stick in the Woo Foo Weapon armory as their very own.

videos.title: Camp Magic Pants
videos.overview: Yin and Yang begin magic training at Camp Magic Pants and become involved in pranks that get them into trouble.

videos.title: Worked Stiff
videos.overview: Yang takes a job at an amusement park that turns out to be anything but fun.

videos.title: Mission Yinpossible
videos.overview: Yin and Yang attempt to prevent Carl from using a pair of magical slippers for evil purposes.

videos.title: Disapp-Eared
videos.overview: Yang casts a spell that makes him disappear and unable to be heard.

videos.title: Get Off My Back
videos.overview: Yin and Yang are magically stuck together by Mastermind so they will learn to cooperate with each other.

videos.title: Slumber Party of Doom
videos.overview: Yin hosts her first slumber party but she drives everyone crazy with her strict schedule.

videos.title: Old Softie
videos.overview: Badfoot tries to steal a powerful artifact from Master Yo.

videos.title: Dance, Dance Devastation
videos.overview: Yin and Yang play a cursed video game, which requires them to keep dancing or die.

videos.title: Upstanding Yuck
videos.overview: Yin and Yang's former enemy Yuck returns and claims to be a reformed rabbit.

videos.title: A Walk in the Woods
videos.overview: Yin and Yang meet a seemingly sweet old lady who really wants to fatten them up and serve them for dinner.

videos.title: Today You Are a Bear?
videos.overview: Yin and Yang want to become bears, but an evil ranger tries to get them mauled by the animals.

videos.title: Pets Peeved
videos.overview: Yang gets a pet but it runs away after he neglects it.

videos.title: For the Love of Clamboy
videos.overview: Yin tricks a clam into liking her so she can steal his jewels.

videos.title: Zarnot's Girlfriend
videos.overview: Zarnot creates a robot girlfriend for himself.

videos.title: The Secret Life of Possum Panda
videos.overview: Yang seeks out a vigilante named Possum Panda, but he discovers solo crime fighting isn't all it's made out to be.

videos.title: Dummy Up
videos.overview: Yang resorts to talking to a dummy after Master Yo leaves town, which infuriates Zarnot.

videos.title: The Howl of The Weenie
videos.overview: Eradicus creates a monster that gains power by consuming everyone's fears, and Yin and Yang try to destroy it.

videos.title: Game Over
videos.overview: Yin and Yang compete with the Manotaur in a game of chance.

videos.title: Creeping With the Enemy
videos.overview: Carl disguises himself as a normal kid to stop Eradicus from carrying out an evil plan that would make everyone bad.

videos.title: The Yindianapolis 500
videos.overview: Yin and Yang are tricked into entering a dangerous car race.

videos.title: Personality Problem
videos.overview: Yuck causes Yin and Yang to swap personalities so he can weaken them and seize power.

videos.title: Season's Beatings
videos.overview: Zarnot disrupts Master Yo's holiday plans.

videos.title: Splitting Hares
videos.overview: Yin and Yang team up with different partners to fight a common enemy.

videos.title: Extra Cheese, Anchovies and Doom!
videos.overview: Yin and Yang tease a pizza-delivery man, so Master Yo makes them deliver pizzas on time or else become a slice themselves.

videos.title: The Confidence Game
videos.overview: Master Yo goes to extreme lengths to get Yin and Yang to take fighting seriously.

videos.title: Roboticus Maximus
videos.overview: Mastermind attempts to destroy the city while Master Yo is absent, so Yin and Yang assemble an army to fight him.

videos.title: Size Matters
videos.overview: Carl tries to make Yang his evil minion.

videos.title: Unmoving Pictures
videos.overview: Yin and Yang are tricked into starring in a movie that is actually a trap set by Eradicus to destroy them.

videos.title: The Recline and Fall of Civilization
videos.overview: Master Yo's recliner is discovered to be inhabited

videos.title: Mind Games
videos.overview: Master Yo tries to teach Yin and Yang how to prevent Ella Mental from reading their minds.

videos.title: The Carl of the Wild
videos.overview: Yin searches for a rare wild beast to protect it from hunters.

videos.title: Clothes Encounters
videos.overview: Yin and Yang's dirty-laundry pile turns into a monster and escapes into town.

videos.title: Commander-in-Cheat
videos.overview: President Muffins enlists help from Yin and Yang in a bid to get reelected.

videos.title: Party Troopers
videos.overview: Yin and Yang throw a party, but Eradicus plans to crash it so he can destroy them.

videos.title: Shadowcluck
videos.overview: Yin falls in love with Coop once again, but their relationship blinds them to Eradicus' plan to destroy the town.

videos.title: Yin! Yang! You!
videos.overview: Leena meets Jason Earles and Mitchel Musso when she lands in Earles' backyard in Hollywood, where the two friends argue over who has the best hair.

videos.title: Division Quest
videos.overview: Eradicus tries to divide the Woo Foo army in order to conquer it. He then takes a vacation at a spa where Master Yo is staying, and the two enemies attempt to get along for the duration of their stays.

videos.title: Yin, Yang... Who?
videos.overview: Yin and Yang search for their parents after Yin is drained of her aura and only a transfusion from a parent will save her.
